[[File:VuffiRaaSphere-NEGTD.png|thumb|right|300px|An adult Silentium]]
The '''Silentium''' were an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] society, native to the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|same galaxy]] as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

==Details==
A species of [[Silentium's creators|star-shaped organics]] created the droids to resemble their form, in much the same way that humanoid [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] created bipedal droids. After the organics were wiped out by a radiation storm from a nearby supernova, their droid creations lived on.<ref name="thonboka">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref>

[[File:VuffiNew.png|thumb|left|A young Silentium]]
These droids continued to reproduce and improve themselves, and developed a culture based on the prime numbers of five, seven, and eleven. Many of them took on the form of geometric shapes, with the circle being the "holiest" of shapes. Thousands of the wisest members of the droid race created powerful fifty-kilometer spheroid bodies.<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> Two influential members of this giant variety included [[The One (being)|The One]] and [[The Other]], and the others were collectively called '''The Rest'''.<ref name="thonboka" />

This new culture of order and symmetry soon brought them into conflict with the chaotic, self-constructing droids known as the [[Abominor]]. The two droid species fought a [[Silentium–Abominor War|galactic war]], ignoring their galaxy's native organic species, until the organic<ref name="NEGTD" /> [[Yuuzhan Vong]]<ref name="TDRA2">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> fought back and forced both droid powers to flee their galaxy.<ref name="NEGTD" />

The Silentium soon found another galaxy to call home, and settled in a place that [[Human/Legends|Humans]] would come to call the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Their reclusive and conservative lifestyle eventually caused them to grow bored, and they created young droids in the image of their organic predecessors to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="NEGTD" />

Mon Calamari boaters saw a giant metallic sphere deposit<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> infant Silentium<ref name="Blog1">{{Blog|danwallace|52|Endnotes for The New Essential Guide to Droids: PART 1 OF 3}}</ref> in the oceans of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], where they became known as [[nano-star]]s.<ref name="Geonosis" /> The scout known as [[Vuffi Raa]] went on to have a wide variety of adventures with numerous masters, including [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="NEGTD" />

The Silentium eventually sought to reclaim their "child," and they revealed themselves to the greater galaxy in the [[Battle of ThonBoka]]. After displaying their power by destroying the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Recalcitrant]]'', they took Vuffi Raa back with them.<ref name="thonboka" />

The Silentium allowed Vuffi Raa to return to visit Calrissian on several occasions,<ref name="NEGTD" /> and the massive spheres continued to be sighted around the galaxy, including a sighting by a hundred thousand beings during the [[Priole Danna Festival]] on [[Lamuir IV]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> a group of Silentium helped [[Lando's Commandos]] kill an Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] named [[Foga Brill/Legends|Foga Brill]].<ref name="warlords">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The war between the Silentium and the Abominor is strongly implied to be the root cause of the technophobia of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], according to Dan Wallace's endnotes for ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''.<ref name="Blog1" /><ref name="Blog2">{{Blog|danwallace|53|Endnotes for The New Essential Guide to Droids: PART 2 of 3}}</ref> This was later confirmed in the second part of the [[Star Wars Blog]] series [[The Droids Re-Animated]].<ref name="TDRA2" />
